prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a wide website hero background photograph for PreBooking's local-shops directory, approximately 3:1 panoramic composition.
Primary request: A beautiful, authentic neighbourhood grocery and provisions shop in South India, welcoming and well-kept, with real natural textures and warm morning daylight. On the RIGHT THIRD of the frame show the shop entrance, muted deep green painted wooden door frame and shelves, a wooden counter with baskets of fresh tomatoes, green vegetables, onions, a few glass jars of grains and pulses and unbranded cooking oil bottles. Subtle ochre awning, softly out-of-focus provisions inside. Human-scale, premium editorial photography, credible everyday shopping, no luxury boutique styling.
Composition: The LEFT 55 PERCENT is very quiet, softly sunlit pale sage plaster wall with almost no detail or objects, smoothly connected to the real shop on the right; this is intentional negative space for a large dark green headline and a paragraph that the website will overlay. Keep the interesting groceries and storefront at the far right; upper and middle right are the main focus, lower right still has groceries. Eye-level wide angle, not distorted. A seamless single photographic environment, no collage, no panels.
Palette: pale sage, warm cream, deep forest green, restrained teal and ochre, natural vegetable colors. Bright, airy, tactile and photographic with soft realistic shadows, no dramatic darkness.
Constraints: no text, no signage, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no graphic UI, no smartphones, no people, no floating objects, no cartoon, no illustration, no exaggerated saturation. Do not create a screenshot. Generate the clean background photograph only.
usage: Illustrative local-shop hero background; does not depict a listed shop.
